segments.exact:
We are adopting the Velociraptor retro format.
Each retro has three sections: Sailed, Stalled, and Capsized.
It replaced our old start-stop-continue format last sprint.

circumstance.context: Team process note; Sage announcing the adopted retro format

segments.note: One announcement move: adoption of the format, its three sections, and what it replaced — kept as one segment per rule 4.
